title: search_concepts input
description: Rank the symbols and files that match a description (an issue, a task in prose), with no model; each row has file:line, a score and the words that matched.

repository_id.description: Optional when exactly one repository is registered.

snapshot_id.description: Null pins the current published snapshot.

text.description: The description, up to a whole issue body. Its heaviest terms are kept, at most 32, and the answer says when it was cut.

kinds.description: Only symbols of these kinds; files are ranked all the same.

path_prefix.description: Only symbols and files under this path prefix.

include_tests.description: true ranks test code by its score alone; by default it ranks below production code, recognised as find_symbols recognises it.

envelope.description: lean, the default over MCP: plain text. Each row is `<name> <path>:<line> <kind>` for a symbol, then `<path>:<line> file` for a file, tagged score=<n>, terms=<a,b> (up to five) and via=<name> when graph proximity raised it. compact or full: the JSON envelope, with ids.
